recipes.name: Peanut butter cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus 2 tablespoons for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until no dry flour shows.
Roll the dough into 1 1/4 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart and press each one with a fork to make a criss cross.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Oatmeal raisin cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in another bowl, then stir it into the butter mix.
Stir in the oats and raisins.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden and the middles still look a little soft.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: For rolling: 3 tablespoons sugar mixed with 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a big bowl for 2 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a soft dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 1/2 inch balls and roll each ball in the cinnamon sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until set at the edges and puffed in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet. They sink and crinkle as they cool.

recipes.name: Double chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar in a big bowl until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes. They should still look soft in the middle.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: White chocolate macadamia cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (135 g) macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the egg, egg yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, then the white chocolate chips and nuts.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Candy-coated chocolate cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix.
Stir in 1 cup of the candies and save the rest.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and press a few extra candies on top of each.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chewy molasses cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and 1 cup of sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and molasses.
Stir in the flour mix.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them in the extra sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tops crack. Bake 2 minutes longer for crisp ginger snaps.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cookies
ingredients: Icing: 1 cup (120 g) powdered sugar mixed with 1 to 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg, molasses and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix until a dough forms.
Split the dough in half, flatten each half into a disk and wrap it.
Chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick on a floured counter and cut out shapes.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are firm.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.
Decorate with the icing once they are completely cool.

recipes.name: Scottish shortbread
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar, plus a little for sprinkling
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and salt until creamy.
Stir in the flour until it comes together as a soft dough.
Press the dough evenly into an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Prick it all over with a fork and sprinkle with a little sugar.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until pale golden at the edges.
Cut it into 16 bars while still warm. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan before lifting out the bars.

recipes.name: Jam thumbprint cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg yolks and vanilla.
Stir in the flour and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 1 inch apart.
Press your thumb into the middle of each ball to make a dent.
Fill each dent with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until the edges are light golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: No-bake chocolate oat cookies
steps: Line 2 baking sheets with wax paper.
Put the butter, sugar, milk and cocoa in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the mix gets very hot.
Bring it to a rolling boil, then boil for 1 minute without stirring.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir in the oats.
Drop spoonfuls onto the wax paper.
Let set for 30 minutes at room temperature.

recipes.name: Monster cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs, vanilla, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats, chocolate chips and candies. There is no flour in these.
Scoop 2 tablespoon balls onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart, and flatten them a little.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Lemon crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the bottoms are just golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chocolate crinkle cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar for rolling
steps: Mix the cocoa, sugar and oil in a big bowl.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cover and chill for 4 hours, until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and roll them thickly in the powdered sugar.
Put them on a lined baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until puffed and cracked.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Snowball cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, plus 1 cup (120 g) for rolling
3/4 cup (85 g) pecans or walnuts, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Stir in the flour, salt and nuts until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into 1 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until set but not brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then roll the warm cookies in powdered sugar.
Let cool completely, then roll them in powdered sugar again.

recipes.name: Oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Stir in the oats and chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto a baking sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Peanut butter blossoms
ingredients: 1/3 cup (65 g) sugar, plus 1/4 cup (50 g) for rolling
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg, milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Roll into 1 inch balls, roll them in the extra sugar and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until light golden.
Right away, press a chocolate kiss into the middle of each cookie. The cookie cracks around it.
Let cool for 1 hour so the chocolate sets.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, cornstarch, baking soda and salt.
Gently stir in the sprinkles.
Roll into 1 1/2 inch balls and put them on a baking sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are set but the tops are still pale.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then move them to a wire rack.

recipes.name: Coconut macaroons
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the coconut, condensed milk and vanilla in a big bowl.
Beat the egg whites and salt in a clean bowl until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the coconut mix.
Scoop 2 tablespoon mounds onto the baking sheet.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden on the outside.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then dip the bottoms in melted chocolate if you like.

recipes.name: Meringue cookies
ingredients: 3 large egg whites, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 225°F (110°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating on high.
Beat until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar has dissolved. Beat in the vanilla and coloring.
Pipe or spoon small mounds onto the sheets.
Bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, until dry and they lift off the paper easily.
Turn off the oven and leave them inside for 1 hour to dry more.

recipes.name: Almond biscotti
ingredients: 1 cup (140 g) whole almonds, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Beat the eggs and both extracts in a small bowl, then stir them into the flour mix.
Stir in the almonds. The dough will be sticky.
Shape it into 2 logs about 12 inches long and 2 inches wide on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until firm and light golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then cut the logs into 1/2 inch slices with a serrated knife. Ask an adult to help.
Lay the slices cut side down and bake for 10 minutes.
Flip them and bake for 10 minutes more, until dry and crisp.

recipes.name: Anzac biscuits
ingredients: 2 tablespoons golden syrup or light corn syrup
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the oats, flour, coconut and brown sugar in a big bowl.
Melt the butter and syrup in a small pot over low heat.
Mix the baking soda with the boiling water and stir it into the butter. It will foam. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the butter mix into the dry mix and stir well.
Roll tablespoons of dough into balls, put them on a lined baking sheet and flatten them a little.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes on the sheet. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Alfajores
ingredients: 1/3 cup (25 g) shredded coconut for rolling
steps: Whisk the cornstarch, flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then beat in the yolks, vanilla and lemon zest.
Stir in the dry mix until a soft dough forms. Wrap it and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut 2 inch circles.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes. They should stay pale.
Let cool for 20 minutes. They are fragile, so handle gently.
Spread dulce de leche on half the cookies and top with the others.
Roll the edges in coconut.

recipes.name: Speculoos spice cookies
ingredients: 1 cup (220 g) packed dark brown sugar
steps: Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg.
Stir in the flour mix. Flatten the dough into a disk, wrap it and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut into rectangles or shapes.
Bake on a lined sheet for 10 to 12 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Let cool on a wire rack. They get crisp as they cool.

recipes.name: Blondies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (85 g) chocolate chips or butterscotch chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Stir the melted butter and brown sugar together.
Stir in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the chips.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and just set in the middle.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.name: Lemon bars
ingredients: Crust: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 1/4 cup (30 g) powdered sugar, 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, pinch of salt
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the crust ingredients until crumbly and press into the pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden.
Whisk the sugar, flour, eggs, lemon juice and zest until smooth.
Pour the lemon mix over the hot crust.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the filling no longer jiggles.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 1 hour.
Dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Magic cookie bars
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
1 cup (115 g) chopped walnuts or pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crumbs and melted butter and press into a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Pour the condensed milk evenly over the crust.
Sprinkle on the chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut and nuts.
Press everything down gently with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden on top.
Let cool completely before cutting into bars.

recipes.name: No-bake peanut butter bars
ingredients: 1 cup (260 g) peanut butter, plus 4 tablespoons for the topping
steps: Line a 9 by 13 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the melted butter, crumbs, powdered sugar and 1 cup peanut butter.
Press the mix evenly into the pan.
Microwave the chocolate chips and 4 tablespoons peanut butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Spread the chocolate over the peanut butter layer.
Chill for 1 hour, until firm.
Let sit for 10 minutes, then cut into bars.

recipes.name: Millionaire shortbread
ingredients: Base: 1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened
Caramel: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar, 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 7 oz (200 g) milk chocolate, chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Rub the base ingredients together, press into the pan and prick with a fork.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until light golden. Let cool.
Put the caramel ingredients in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, hot caramel burns.
Stir all the time for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick and golden.
Pour the caramel over the base and chill for 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time, stirring each time, and spread it over the caramel.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut into squares with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Nanaimo bars
ingredients: Base: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 5 tablespoons cocoa powder, 1 egg, beaten
Middle: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, softened, 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons custard powder, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar
Top: 4 oz (115 g) semisweet chocolate and 2 tablespoons butter
steps: Put the base butter, sugar and cocoa in a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water. Ask an adult to help.
Stir until melted, then whisk in the egg and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Stir in the crumbs, coconut and walnuts, and press into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan. Chill for 30 minutes.
Beat the middle layer ingredients until smooth and spread over the base. Chill for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and butter together and spread over the top.
Chill for 1 hour, then cut with a hot knife.

recipes.name: Oatmeal jam bars
ingredients: 1 cup (320 g) raspberry or strawberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, baking soda and salt, then stir in the melted butter.
Press 2/3 of the mix into the pan.
Spread the jam over it, leaving a small border.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumbs on top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: S'mores bars
ingredients: 3 milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz / 44 g each)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, crumbs, baking powder and salt.
Press half the dough into a lined 8 by 8 inch pan.
Lay the chocolate bars on top, then spread on the marshmallow creme.
Flatten small pieces of the rest of the dough and lay them over the marshmallow.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.name: Cream cheese brownies
ingredients: Swirl: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 1 egg yolk, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment paper.
Microwave the butter and chocolate for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Stir in the sugar, then the eggs and vanilla, then the flour and salt.
Beat the swirl ingredients until smooth.
Spread most of the brownie batter in the pan, drop spoonfuls of the swirl on top, then the rest of the batter.
Drag a knife through to make swirls.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the swirl is set.
Let cool for 1 hour, then chill before cutting.

recipes.name: Edible cookie dough
steps: Raw flour can carry germs, so heat it first. Microwave the flour in a bowl for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until it reaches 165°F (74°C) on a thermometer, about 90 seconds total.
Let the flour cool for 10 minutes.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until creamy.
Stir in the milk, vanilla and salt.
Stir in the flour, then the chocolate chips.
Eat with a spoon, or roll into balls and chill for 30 minutes. There is no egg, so it is safe to eat.

recipes.name: Pumpkin bars
ingredients: Frosting: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Beat the eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until smooth, spread over the cake and cut into bars.

recipes.name: Skillet chocolate chip cookie
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 inch oven-safe skillet.
Stir the melted butter, brown sugar and sugar, then stir in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Press the dough evenly into the skillet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden at the edges and soft in the middle.
Let cool for 10 minutes. The skillet stays very hot, so use oven mitts. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.name: Chocolate sandwich cookies
ingredients: Filling: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, 1/4 cup (50 g) shortening, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 teaspoons vanilla
steps: Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg. Stir in the dry mix.
Wrap the dough and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 2 inch circles.
Bake on a lined sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.
Let cool completely.
Beat the filling ingredients until smooth.
Spread filling on half the cookies and press the others on top.

recipes.name: Pecan sandies
steps: Beat the butter, powdered sugar, brown sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Stir in the flour, salt and pecans.
Shape the dough into a 2 inch wide log, wrap it and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Slice the log into 1/4 inch rounds and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Let cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Brownie cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Microwave the chocolate and butter for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth. Let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 3 minutes, until pale and thick.
Beat in the chocolate and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt, then the chips.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes so it thickens.
Scoop 2 tablespoon mounds onto a lined sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until shiny and cracked on top.
Let cool for 10 minutes on the sheet.

recipes.name: Black and white cookies
aliases: new york black and white cookies
ingredients: Icing: 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar, 3 to 4 tablespoons milk, 1 tablespoon light corn syrup, 3 tablespoons cocoa powder
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg, vanilla and lemon zest.
Stir in half the flour, baking soda and salt, then the buttermilk, then the rest of the flour.
Scoop 1/4 cup mounds onto lined sheets, 3 inches apart.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until the edges are golden. Let cool completely.
Mix the powdered sugar, milk and corn syrup into a thick, smooth icing.
Spread white icing over the flat bottom side of half of each cookie.
Stir the cocoa into the rest of the icing, adding a little milk, and spread it on the other halves.
Let set for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chinese almond cookies
ingredients: 1 large egg, plus 1 yolk for brushing
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, almond flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and almond extract.
Stir in the dry mix.
Roll 1 inch balls, put them on a lined sheet and flatten each one a little.
Press an almond into each and brush with the beaten yolk.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Let cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Chocolate cutout cookies
steps: Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mix, split into 2 disks, wrap and chill for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll 1/4 inch thick on a lightly floured counter and cut shapes.
Bake on a lined sheet for 8 to 10 minutes, until the tops look dry.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, then decorate once cool.

recipes.name: Frosted sugar cookie bars
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar, 3 tablespoons milk, 1 teaspoon vanilla, food coloring
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Spread the dough evenly in the pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the edges are just golden.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients, spread on top and add sprinkles. Cut into bars.

recipes.name: Florentine lace cookies
ingredients: 3 oz (85 g) chocolate, melted, for drizzling
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter, brown sugar, corn syrup and cream in a pot over medium heat, stirring, until it just boils. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and stir in the flour, oats, vanilla and salt.
Drop level teaspoons onto parchment-lined sheets, 3 inches apart. They spread a lot.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly and golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet, until firm enough to move.
Drizzle with melted chocolate.
